scheme.why_this_scheme: Identical to the old site (games/cheats.py sha()). The game scripts embed the same hashes between /*CH[*/ and /*]CH*/ (written by games/cheat_defaults/build.py) and compare the hash of what the player types/dials, so keeping the scheme means the ported JS works unchanged.
scheme.old_verification: Server never verified cheat codes. views.play renders cheats.page_config(): for each enabled cheat {id, typed: sha(slug,typed), dial: sha(slug,dial)} in data-gm-config; the browser hashes the player input and compares. Codes switched off or not allowed for the viewer (access rules) are left out. Scores reported with a cheat are flagged ArcadeScore.cheated.
scheme.security_note: Codes are short and low-entropy, so the hashes are guessable by brute force; they only stop casual reading, exactly as before.
